messages.author: b19f231547b6c85d
messages.subject: help for labels_bquote
parts:
I want to use math expressions as labels in panels obtained from
facet_grid(). I saw that new functions labels_bquote or perhaps
labels_parsed added in ggplot2 0.8.3 could do this, but ?labels_bquote
or ?labels_parsed doesn't return anything. And I couldn't find
anything on ggplot.had.co.nz either. Where can I find instructions/
examples on these functions? I'm using ggplot2 0.8.7.

Thanks

Etienne

messages.subject: Re: help for labels_bquote
parts:
Maybe I just don't get how one should use it (quite possible), but
compare the output of,

qplot(x,y, data=data.frame(x=1:2,y=1:2, f =
factor(c("alpha","beta"))), geom="point") +
facet_grid(.~f, labeller= label_bquote(.(x)))

## alpha, beta

qplot(x,y, data=data.frame(x=1:2,y=1:2, f =
factor(c("alpha","beta"))), geom="point") +
facet_grid(.~f, labeller= label_bquote("this is "==.(x)))

## this is = 0, this is = 1

Baptiste

messages.author: b19f231547b6c85d
messages.subject: Re: help for labels_bquote
parts:
Got it, thanks for your help Baptiste -- label_bquote is actually what I
need, because my facet labels are something like: X, Y, Z, and I wanted
to have something like X_a, Y_a, Z_a on the figure, so the following
will do this in one step:

... + facet_grid( ~ fac, labeller = label_bquote(.(x)_a ) )

This avoids me having to rename all the labels manually, so it is an
example where label_bquote is clearly useful.

Etienne
